Why Stellar · Stellar Composed

We never hold your money.
A public contract on Stellar does.

  • The core · we wrote it

    Soroban smart contract

    locked on Stellar

    Pays the seller only with the code in their one-time QR. Refunds the buyer if it falls through.

  • OpenZeppelin · Nido

    Smart Accounts with passkeys

    The buyer pays with Face ID. Nothing to write down.

  • Stellar protocol

    Stellar Asset Contracts

    tEUR, tUSD, tGBP, tBRL as Soroban tokens.

  • Stellar protocol · SDEX

    Path Payments + Liquidity Pools

    Pay in reais. She gets euros.

  • Reflector · SEP-40

    Reflector FX Oracle

    Live €, $, £, R$ rates, read on-chain.

    OpenZeppelin Channels

    Every fee paid for you. No XLM.

    Account and trustlines opened in one tap.

    Cash out to a bank.

    Every step public on Stellar Expert.

Who's first

For the moment neither stranger
wants to go first.

Who

Buyers and sellers of used goods, meeting in person. We start with bikes, consoles and electronics in Lisbon.

The problem

The buyer wants to check the item before paying. The seller wants the funds confirmed before handing it over.

Why SHAKE

The money stays locked, and the seller can check it. The buyer pays only after they've looked.

Find it on OLX. Arrange it on WhatsApp. Complete the handover with SHAKE.

The extension and a shared link. No marketplace has to partner with us.

HypothesisFive pairs outside the team. Can they finish without help? Does the seller trust “funds locked”? Would they choose SHAKE next time?

Technical workflow

What has to happen before anyone is paid.
A screenshot can do none of it.

  1. 01

    The deal, elsewhere

    Vinted, OLX or WhatsApp. SHAKE never lists the item.

  2. 02

    The buyer locks 400€

    Face ID. A public contract on Stellar holds it. The seller checks the lock, not a picture.

  3. 03

    Both phones. One code.

    The code exists only on the seller’s screen, once. The buyer scans it. Then the seller is paid.

  4. 04

    No meetup, it returns

    The time runs out. The same contract sends the money back to the buyer.

A photo of a payment has nothing to scan.The lock is public. Anyone can check it.No marketplace has to add SHAKE.

“We buy and sell second-hand all the time.
